A couple notes:

- If you want to avoid the vessel yard demurrage, we can divert the container to a bonded warehouse (we have a bonded yard partner at Oakland Consolidated Bonded - quote included below). Bonded diversion estimate: $1,250 (diversion + drayage + yard handling)
Estimated lumper / ad-hoc charges if left on release: $450 - $900 depending on dock handling
